limits: Flat menu with1–10 digits0–9, authored RU/KK prompts and labels; no nested graph or automatic translation. Draft can lack prompts; publication requires both.

5–300 seconds from server start;1–5 invalid digits. Deadline never extends. Time/read alone does not write; owner must submit an action. At or after deadline timeout outranks valid digit or cancellation. No background scheduler.
Wall-clock rollback before last event refuses; a forward clock jump may expire the session. Tests inject clocks; no claim of synchronized distributed time or carrier timing.
Only starting owner appends. Admin cannot bypass owner. All staff read shared workspace; not tenant/customer isolation. Session ownership is not proof of identity or training performance.

One event per successful command; used UUID keys refuse, not idempotent successful replay. Global revision also conflicts unrelated changes; expectedSeq independently guards ordered events. UI preview/hash not required by HTTP and not proof of human approval.

Publication/session snapshots and past events immutable. No full intermediate draft text history. Published version stays consumed after archive. Archive closes new starts; active old sessions continue; active session cannot be archived/reopened/transferred.
Unsigned JSON/hash check consistency, not authenticity; users/auth sessions/audit excluded; restore only empty workspace. HTTPJSON2MB; reserve full SQLite consistently separately.
No real phone/number/audio/DTMF carrier/ASR/TTS/LLM/messages/real handover/integration/payment. Model outcome is not external service, delivery, consent or learning result.
No password reset/session revocation UI, public server hosting, load test, full touch/screenreader/mobile or external security audit.
